request_coverage.request: Use scroll mostly for code, feature lists, and popups.
request_coverage.evidence: UI policy names code editors/viewers, terminal/log panes, long lists, popup/dialog/flyout menus, and inspector panes as bounded scroll surfaces.

request_coverage.request: Avoid applying scroll to the whole main tab/screen whenever possible.
request_coverage.evidence: Persistent instructions and `check-scroll-containers.mjs` prohibit whole-tab scroll ownership on `.desktop-viewport` and `.mounted-section-panel`.
